      "evidence": [

      "asvs": ["V8.3.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-311"],
      "plainLanguage": "Card details stay stored in the stream and in every system that reads it, so one break-in exposes the history.",

        "title": "Minimise card data in events and bound retention",

        "when": "it is written to the topic",
        "then": "the payload carries only a payment reference and non-card fields needed by consumers (card BIN and last four replaced by a token), and topic retention is limited to the shortest period consumers need"
      }

        { "quote": "Payment events are published to a Kafka topic that every internal service can consume." }

        "title": "Record authenticated producer identity per event",
        "given": "a message produced to the payments topic",
        "when": "the broker accepts it",
        "then": "the authenticated producer principal is bound to the message and retained in an audit trail that consumers and investigators can query"
      }
    }
  ]
